verdict.rationale: Sentry publishes self-hosted docs explicitly for running the full platform on your own server for free, which developers use to spin up local/dev instances for testing instrumentation and dashboards; community reports confirm this works well long-term but also cite it as resource-heavy and self-hosted setup carries 'no guarantees or dedicated support' for the minimal out-of-the-box version. Missing for 10: a lightweight official local dev-mode/quickstart (e.g. single docker-compose command) with independent confirmation it's easy and low-resource, since community evidence shows real friction (heavy memory/container usage).
